verdict.rationale: Wave is a SaaS accounting product with a GraphQL API, so an interactive API reference is a fair question. However, its developer portal could not be crawled (403), and its marketing pages document no API reference or runnable examples. A live GraphQL endpoint with introspection enabled is at most a developer building block, not a documented interactive reference with runnable examples, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
